About the job
Elbkai Freight Technologies builds the digital freight platform behind more than 4,000 European carriers and shippers. Since our Series C in 2025 we have grown from 280 to 610 people in Hamburg, Rotterdam and Kraków. Growth has outpaced our organisation: product, operations and sales work in different set-ups, decision rights are unclear and our quarterly planning no longer holds.

Our leadership team has agreed on a new operating model built around three customer segments. We are looking for an experienced transformation lead on a fractional basis who helps us design the details and lands the change across the company, working closely with our COO.

What you will do
• Own the design of the target operating model with the leadership team: segment organisation, decision rights, interfaces between product, operations and commercial teams
• Set up and run a small transformation office with four internal workstream owners
• Introduce an OKR-based quarterly planning cycle and a lean portfolio review for cross-team initiatives
• Plan and run the change journey: leadership alignment sessions, manager enablement, town halls and pulse surveys
• Prepare decisions for the executive team and the monthly board meeting, track progress and risks
• Work with the works council on the information and consultation process for the new structure
• Hand over the transformation office to an internal lead by the end of the assignment

What you bring
• 10+ years in organisational transformation, operating model design or change management, ideally in scale-ups or technology companies
• Experience leading transformation programmes at executive level as an interim or fractional leader
• Strong facilitation skills and a pragmatic, low-bureaucracy approach
• Familiarity with OKRs, agile ways of working and product organisations
• Fluent English; German is a plus for the works council topics

Conditions
• Start: Q1 2027 (January or February)
• Duration: 6 months, extension possible
• Workload: fractional, 2 days per week, one of them in our Hamburg office
• Rate: EUR 1,250 per day
• Freelance contract directly with Elbkai Freight Technologies GmbH

Send us a short note on a comparable transformation you have led and your availability. Our COO, J. P., will get back to you within a week.
